en: You (pl.) don't swim in this pool.

en: He is going to swim in the sea tomorrow.

lat: hiya ma ghadish t3um ghedda f s-sba7
ar: هي ما غاديش تعوم غدا فالصباح
en: She is not going to swim tomorrow morning.

lat: ntuma ma ghadish t3umu f had l-berd
ar: نتوما ما غاديش تعومو فهاد البرد
en: You (pl.) are not going to swim in this cold.

en: They are going to swim in that river.

en: The boys are not going to swim in the pool.
